title: Passage 6  Sam's Healthy Habits
subtitle: 考点：综合时态（一般过去 / 现在 / 将来）
passage: Last year, Sam was not healthy. He ate too much junk food and didn't do any exercise. He often felt tired in class. His doctor told him to change his habits, so now Sam eats more fruit and vegetables. He drinks a lot of water, too.

Every morning he runs for 20 minutes in the park. He is stronger now because he exercises every day, and he feels happy. Sam says, "I will keep these good habits, and I will help my friends do the same."
vocab: junk food 垃圾食品 · exercise 锻炼 · tired 疲倦的 · habit 习惯 · vegetable 蔬菜 · keep 保持

questions.stem: What did Sam eat too much last year?
questions.why: 原文：He ate too much junk food.

questions.stem: What did the doctor tell Sam to do?
questions.why: 原文：His doctor told him to change his habits.

questions.stem: What does Sam do every morning now?
options: He runs in the park for 20 minutes.
questions.why: 原文：Every morning he runs for 20 minutes in the park.

questions.stem: How does Sam feel now?
questions.why: 原文：he feels happy. 疲倦是以前的状态。

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Sam did a lot of exercise last year.
questions.why: 原文：didn't do any exercise（没做任何锻炼）。

questions.stem: Sam drinks a lot of water now.
questions.why: 原文：He drinks a lot of water, too.

questions.stem: Sam runs for 30 minutes every morning.
questions.why: 原文：runs for 20 minutes。

questions.stem: Sam wants to help his friends.
questions.why: 原文：I will help my friends do the same.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: He ate too much junk food ____ didn't do any exercise.
questions.why: 并列两件事，用 and。

questions.stem: He often felt tired ____ class.
questions.why: in class 在课上。

questions.stem: His doctor told him ____ change his habits.
questions.why: tell sb. to do sth. 告诉某人做某事。

questions.stem: His doctor told him to change his habits, ____ now Sam eats more fruit.
questions.why: 前因后果，用 so。

questions.stem: Every morning he runs ____ 20 minutes in the park.
questions.why: for 20 minutes 持续了 20 分钟。

questions.stem: He is stronger now ____ he exercises every day.
questions.why: 说明原因，用 because。

sections.title: 四、用动词的适当形式填空

questions.stem: Last week we ____ to the park.
questions.why: Last week 表示过去；go 的过去式是 went。

questions.stem: She ____ TV every evening.
questions.why: every evening 经常性动作，一般现在时；She 单数，watch → watches。

questions.stem: Look! The boys ____ basketball.
questions.why: Look! 提示正在进行：are playing。

questions.stem: I ____ my aunt next Sunday.
questions.why: next Sunday 将来，will + 原形：will visit。

questions.stem: He ____ his homework yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday 过去；否定句用 didn't + 动词原形：didn't do。

questions.stem: Listen! Who ____ in the next room?
questions.why: Listen! 提示正在进行；Who 当单数：is singing。
